description: Google Cloud (GCP) assistant and operator via the `ask_cloud_operator` MCP tool (the autocloud server, or any server that offers it). Use for any GCP request: how-to, resources, Terraform/Kubernetes/Helm, rollouts, incidents, costs. Invoke it before answering a GCP question from your own knowledge or documentation search, and before proposing an architecture or backend, even when no cloud is named. Invoke it before reading or editing local *.tf or Kubernetes YAML. Don't use for non-GCP tasks or local machine setup like installing gcloud and setting up GCP.
